 Corinthians name starting XI for Libertadores group finale against Independiente Santa Fe 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Corinthians have confirmed their line-up to face Independiente Santa Fe in the CONMEBOL Libertadores Feminina at 17:00 Brasília time at Banco Guayaquil in Ecuador, with top spot in Group A at stake. According to Meu Timao, a draw will be enough to finish first.
 Head coach Emily Lima starts with Lelê in goal, with Ivana Fuso, Thaís Regina, Erika , Thaís Ferreira and Tamires ahead of her. The midfield is Dayana Rodríguez, Duda Sampaio and Letícia Monteiro, with Belén Aquino and Vic Albuquerque in attack.
 OneFootball Videos
 The bench comprises Nicole Ramos, Gisela Robledo, Gabi Zanotti, Ariel Godoi, Paola Garcia, Duda Mineira and Ana Vitória.
 Santa Fe name Domínguez, Cristancho, Pérez, Motta, Valbuena, Ortegon, Cabrera, Ibarguen, Baldallo, Garavito and Zamorano.
 Corinthians have three absences. Left-back Juliete remains out after discomfort in the back of her left thigh. Midfielder Andressa Alves is recovering from a left ankle sprain from the Caracas match and is not expected to be available, while Jhonson has shoulder pain after falling awkwardly while winning a penalty against the Venezuelan club Caracas.
 Both sides arrive on six points and share the lead in Group A. Corinthians are the competition’s most successful club, having lifted the trophy in 2017, 2019, 2021, 2023, 2024 and 2025.
 Source: Meu Timao
